open_points.subject: Backup snapshot contents versus excluded agent sessions
open_points.text: The changed rule says a backup "holds the store as its snapshot saw it" and that "a later backup holds whatever the store holds when its own snapshot is taken," while A18 rule 2 says, "A backup holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted."
open_points.question: Does the snapshot-content guarantee mean the exact store snapshot, including agent sessions, or the snapshot after all agent-session records have been removed?
options: The backup is an exact snapshot and therefore contains agent sessions.
The backup is the snapshot with all agent sessions removed, so "whatever the store holds" has that exception.
open_points.default_guess: Treat rule 2 as an explicit exception: back up the snapshot after removing every agent session.

witness.initial: The store contains a registered agent session with a granted project and active project.
events: Cabinet Kernel leaves that session registered.
The daily backup takes its snapshot while the session record exists.
The owner later restores that backup after loss of the store.
outcomes: Because the backup holds the store as its snapshot saw it, the restored store contains the session and its grant.
Because agent sessions are removed before encryption, the restored store contains no session or grant.
witness.observer: The owner and Cabinet Kernel after the restore
